categories.main_business_segments: The Scotts Miracle-Gro Company operates through three main segments: U.S. Consumer, Hawthorne, and Other. The U.S. Consumer segment focuses on branded consumer lawn and garden products in the United States. The Hawthorne segment provides products for indoor and hydroponic gardening, while the Other segment primarily covers the consumer lawn and garden business in Canada.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary formulations and technologies in fertilizers, plant foods, pesticides, and hydroponic systems. Manufacturing involves blending, packaging, and distribution of chemical and organic products, as well as the development of patented dispensing devices, lighting systems, and hydroponic growing environments. R&D focuses on new product formulations, packaging, and process improvements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Scotts Miracle-Gro primarily serves home centers, mass merchandisers, warehouse clubs, large hardware chains, independent hardware stores, nurseries, garden centers, e-commerce platforms, and hydroponic retailers and growers. Its largest customers are The Home Depot and Lowe’s, which together accounted for 52% of net sales in 2025.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s primary market is North America, with the majority of sales in the United States and a significant presence in Canada. It also operates in Mexico and China, with manufacturing, distribution, and R&D facilities in these regions. International sales are primarily through the Other segment and select Hawthorne operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Scotts Miracle-Gro operates downstream in the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing, marketing, and distribution of finished consumer and professional products. It sources raw materials globally and sells primarily to retailers and distributors, with some direct-to-consumer and e-commerce sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include driving innovation in branded consumer lawn and garden products, expanding the indoor and hydroponic gardening portfolio, and enhancing supply chain efficiency. R&D investments target new product development, improved formulations, packaging innovation, and leveraging supplier and partner research. Sustainability, ESG initiatives, and digital engagement are also key focus areas.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of branded and private label products to retailers, distributors, and direct consumers. Additional revenue streams include commissions and reimbursements from the exclusive marketing agreement with Monsanto for Roundup-branded products, as well as licensing and joint venture income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Spectrum Brands, Central Garden & Pet, Kellogg Garden Products, Oldcastle Retail, Lebanon Seaboard, Reckitt Benckiser, FoxFarm, Nanolux, Sun Gro Horticulture, Procter & Gamble, Advanced Nutrients, and Hydrofarm. Scotts Miracle-Gro is the market leader in U.S. consumer lawn and garden products, with strong brand recognition and broad retail relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal year 2025, net sales were $3.41 billion, down 3.9% from the prior year. The company returned to profitability with net income of $145.2 million after losses in 2023 and 2024, and improved gross margin to 30.6%. The U.S. Consumer segment remains the largest contributor, while the Hawthorne segment has contracted due to industry headwinds.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Scotts Miracle-Gro emphasizes trusted, widely recognized brands, product innovation, and quality as its core differentiators. The company offers comprehensive solutions for lawn, garden, and indoor growing needs, supported by strong retail partnerships, supply chain capabilities, and consumer marketing. Exclusive rights to market Roundup-branded products and a focus on sustainability further enhance its competitive positioning.
